author: KennyVale
description: AbstractElectrocardiograms (ECGs) are essential for diagnosing arrhythmias, myocardial ischemia, and conduction disorders. While machine learning has achieved expert-level performance in ECG interpretation, the development of clinically deployable multimodal aI systems is limited by the lack of public datasets that integrate raw signals, diagnostic images, and interpretation text.
